name: M7.Factorized.pair_count
statement: ∀ (S T : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (left : S → Prop) (right : T → Prop), M7.Factorized.count (fun p : S × T => left p.1 ∧ right p.2) = M7.Factorized.count left * M7.Factorized.count right
guidance: Identify filtered product with product of the two filtered univs by Finset.ext; use Finset.card_product. Explicit mem_filter rewrites avoid stalled simp under classical local deciders. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
